description: SLA - Arrêts de bus is a dataset listed in Open Data Saint-Louis Agglomération, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Saint-Louis Agglomération. Localisation des arrêts de bus présents sur le territoire de Saint-Louis Agglomération ainsi que les arrêts du réseau urbain "Distribus" sur les territoires limitrophes qui sont desservis par le service de transport en commun de Saint-Louis Agglomération. Coverage: Saint-Louis Agglomération (Haut-Rhin). The portal files it under Transports, Mobilités. Its keywords are transport en commun, mobilité. The portal shows 356 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-saint-louis-agglo-portal.
